notes.title: Devlog Roadmap #1
notes.content:
Dear managers,


It’s been a little over two weeks since the launch of PBS, and first of all, I want to thank you for your feedback, both positive and negative. I was truly moved to see that some of you have already spent dozens and dozens of hours in the game. For me, it’s both an honor and a responsibility: to make sure you are fully satisfied.



The first update of the ⬇️ Roadmap ⬇️ is now in development. This devlog is here to give you a sneak peek of what we’ve been preparing for you.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/e7d871037d0d51e844a55ff05474ea34c0a6a2a2.png"]

 
New decoration items


In this upcoming update, a first wave of new decoration items will arrive, giving you more ways to personalize your brasserie and add your unique touch.

 

The customization system will also be improved with the ability to copy the style of one item and apply it to another in a single click. Example: select a table with the roller to copy its style, then apply it directly to other tables.



Another highly requested feature: the interior walls of the brasserie will now be separated, allowing you to customize the ground floor and the upper floor independently.



The double swing doors will also become customizable, so they can perfectly match the style you’ve chosen.



New items included:

New textures for interior walls

New textures for floors

New tables

New plants: for floors, walls, and tables

New lamps: for walls, ceilings, and tables

Two new bars

Three new staircases

New storefronts replacing the current one (the red curtain with your brasserie’s name)

We’ve created a variety of styles so you can shape the atmosphere that suits you: classic, rustic, modern, chic — or even mix multiple vibes (one style on the ground floor and another upstairs).

 
Here’s a preview of some of the new decorations — but not all of them 🤐


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/be99b944072a797572f15b90f6bcf544fd9da3be.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/f09ca09a37b8a45a570f47187b82c082cc5e699c.png"]

Tip: start saving up some money in your brasserie, because these new features won’t be free 😉

 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/148ed752c6f56a24bcb4d18ade75fc808c24b7e3.gif"] 


New dishes
 

As you may know, in France food is a true institution. But this passion goes far beyond our borders: all around the world, players have confessed to drooling over the dishes in the game and asking for more!

 

Our artist is hard at work producing as many new recipes as possible. It’s a time-consuming process, as each dish is carefully modeled and hand-painted (no artificial intelligence here!).

 

At the time of writing this devlog, we already have three desserts and two dishes (one still in progress). Here’s a sneak peek: the Mille-feuille, the Madeleines, and to finish on an alcoholic note, Canelés. The most observant among you will also notice the new plate design 🍽️

 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/957751be67fab42b4d7c48441a623606d2b46813.png"] 


Overhauled day system


Based on your feedback — and our own experience — we realized the game was missing a clear framework to give rhythm to your days. Time used to flow endlessly, making it hard to know when to take a break, place orders, or check your sales. We’ve decided to add a system that keeps freedom for those who enjoy it, while bringing more structure overall.



Time still runs on a 24-hour virtual cycle lasting a total of 30 real minutes:



- At 6 AM, your brasserie opens automatically (unless you’ve already opened it earlier yourself).  
- At 11 PM, the doors close and time freezes. You then finish serving your last customers and must go to the computer to end the day. Three choices are available:


[olist]
Free time: time resumes and you can do whatever you like (decoration, orders, etc. — yes, night orders will be possible).

Skip to the next day: time advances automatically until 5 AM, just before reopening.

Continue service: time resumes immediately and the brasserie reopens automatically.


[/olist]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/97becf7ce9efb0a64c838948fa6015f05d227d66.jpg"]


Steam Achievements


Over 30 achievements will be available, organized into tiers, to provide new challenges for mission lovers and completionists aiming for 100%.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/44bc7ee4289ffa11974774ed3079eb778b164e61.jpg"] 


Quality of Life improvements (QOL)


Alongside the major new features, this update will also include many fixes and changes to make your experience more enjoyable. They will all be listed in detail in the patch notes, but here’s an early preview:



- Added a difficulty system  
- Night orders enabled  
- Bread now served by the receptionist  
- Ingredients and Menu apps merged for easier stock management  
- Sodas are now placed directly on the bar instead of in the mini-fridge




And many more features are in the works — the release is coming very soon, just a little more patience 🥐

notes.title: Update 1.0.2_2.b7c2: Table Numbers & Bugs
notes.content:
Dear Managers,



Here are the changes included in this version. They mainly come from your feedback, as well as some bugs we detected.


Rework of table numbers
When ordering a dish with the tablet, it is no longer necessary to select a table. A dish ordered without an associated table will not have a ticket with a table number.

For dishes ordered and associated with a table, it is now possible to deliver them to another table with a different number. This is no longer blocked.

Employees will now only pick up dishes from the counter if they are associated with a table.


Changes
- Serving dishes by employees is now counted towards mission objectives to unlock new dishes.

- Boxes containing a floor can now be resold to Joe.


Fixes
- Fixed the truck not leaving its delivery point.

- Fixed an issue that caused tables to be marked as invalid (red) without any valid reason.


[hr][/hr]


Reminder

If, when starting your game, you see some of your tables marked in red, it means their placement is invalid. Simply move them to fix it.



What's next?

We are moving into a new phase of adjustments and bug fixes, including:

- a parameter to adjust how quickly satisfaction increases 

- a key to toggle sprint

- a better sales report



At the same time, we are progressing on the roadmap, including:

- achievements coming very soon

- a new language being added in the game

- new decoration props (we will release a devlog dedicated to this topic)

notes.title: Devlog #5: A Little Helping Hand 🤵 👩🏻‍💼
notes.content:
Dear Managers,

As promised last week, we're excited to present the first version of the employee system.

Hiring Employees

🚨 The salaries shown in the screenshots below are not final.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/677222bfd1096e91e99a2c6c48a8e9ab97d607d9.png

A new app is now available on your computer, allowing you to recruit staff based on your current hiring capacity.

Your hiring capacity will grow as you progress through the game by unlocking mission rewards.

There are 4 types of employees:

 A receptionist: Greets customers and assigns them to tables
 A bartender: Prepares and serves drinks, and handles payment
 A waiter: Takes orders, serves dishes, and clears tables
 A head chef: Prepares all the dishes


Every night at midnight, when a new day begins, your employees' wages are deducted. If you can’t pay an employee due to insufficient funds, they’ll go on unpaid leave and stop coming to work.

Managing Your Staff

Once hired, your staff can be managed from another app on your computer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/9249a11e5541ef86575fb26fa61ac21b9afff6b3.png

From this screen, you can fire employees or put them on leave. An employee on leave won’t show up to work and will only receive 20% of their salary.

If an employee is awaiting payment, you’ll see it here. Simply pay their salary to bring them back to their post.

Assigning Your Staff

As shown in the image above, you can assign your waiters and bartenders to a specific floor: ground floor, first floor… or maybe something more mysterious…

An employee assigned to a floor will only take care of tables on that floor. They will only go downstairs when needed to access the kitchen. Systems are in place to reduce back-and-forth between floors—sharp-eyed players will notice.

Naming Your Staff

You can rename your employees, and you’ll see their name displayed on a badge on their chest. What will you call them?

Order Coordination

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/cb223edd678e2dccb85237faa6bc6d5ffe35e3c0.png

To avoid employees colliding with players, you’ll now see an indicator on customer orders showing when an employee has taken charge of it.

That way, you can pick up only the orders that haven’t yet been claimed by a waiter or bartender—depending on whether it's a dish or a drink.

Conclusion

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/a3d13f8c1968fac9be1030f2f449b9677ff3dd78.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/80859a639a9cd391934d8ac31c223954e00031e9.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/c37e5895a92465fbc40a4f4d0dbff899433b229d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/a0225d0486c6d4cccee4c4b1c809da8c888ac223.png

Thanks for reading this devlog! We’ll be back next week with another exciting topic.
In the meantime, feel free to share your thoughts on the system, and don’t forget:

👉 Try the demo for free, solo or with up to 4 players in co-op
👉 Join our Discord to stay up to date and chat with the community

– The Quark Studios Team

notes.title: Devlog #2: Carts, Carts Everywhere
notes.content:
Dear Managers 🥐

We’re happy to kick off this second devlog with an announcement: from now on, we’ll be sharing one devlog every week!

Today’s update introduces two new carts:

 One to help you carry dishes,
 And another to help you unload boxes from the delivery truck more easily.

You can buy as many of them as you need.

The dish cart lets you transport a large number of items:

 Up to 10 ready-to-serve dishes,
 50 dirty plates,
 And dozens of glasses.

This will greatly optimize your trips between the kitchen and the dining area.
Even better—you can interact directly with tables and the sink, without needing to use the tray!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/a0e066dfc689986971e8450c4acf1dba42ecbfbc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/053ab4de3139f3f5cd87e1d977badae64be6ae4c.png

To speed up deliveries, in addition to two delivery workers who now run instead of walk, you also have access to a hand truck that can carry up to 3 boxes at once.
And maybe... just maybe... it has another surprise use too 👀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/174d0d4f210e9fcc4484fdd563192ebcb8ebc49a.png

That’s it for this devlog! See you next week for another brand-new feature.

In the meantime, feel free to try the free multiplayer mode in the Parisian Brasserie Simulator demo — up to 4 players!

Join us on Discord to stay up to date in real time.

– The Quark Studios Team

notes.title: Play the Demo During Steam Neofest !
notes.content:
The wait is over – Steam Neofest is here! For one whole week, you can play the demo of Parisian Brasserie Simulator and step into the shoes of a brasserie manager in the heart of Paris. Whether you're crafting the perfect menu, handling demanding customers, or expanding your business, this is your chance to experience the charm of running your own Parisian brasserie!

📅 What’s Next? Check Out Our Roadmap!
Now that the demo is available, we want to share what’s planned for the future of Parisian Brasserie Simulator. Below, you’ll find our roadmap, outlining the features and improvements we aim to develop after this demo version.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279628/3cabf834c98d47b80ffd4bb285684e5f9a9186ec.png

💡 New Player? We’ve Got You Covered!
To help you get started, we've prepared a Beginner’s Guide with useful tips and tricks. Check it out here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3422622173

🐞 Found a Bug? Need Help?
If you encounter any issues, feel free to join our Discord – we’re actively providing support and collecting feedback from players!

Discord

⚠ Crashing on Launch? Try This!
Some players might experience crashes when launching the game. If that happens, we recommend running the game with DirectX 11 instead of DirectX 12. Please, don't forget to update your graphic drivers, it's an important step.

This is an exciting moment for us, and we’d love to hear your thoughts! Try the demo, share your feedback, and let’s make Parisian Brasserie Simulator the best it can be!

🥂 See you in the brasserie! 🥐
